scope: US IEEE/NIST reference baseline with international IEC and equipment-specific profiles; utility, jurisdiction and AHJ not selected.
selectionRule: Select one coherent tested profile per interface. Alternatives are not simultaneous mandatory requirements.

standards.reference: IEEE 1547-2018 + 1547a-2020; owner lists revision in ballot April2026
standards.applicability: Core US DER
standards.operationalRole: PCC interconnection, abnormal operation/ride-through, reactive power, interoperability; utility-approved settings and device certificates
standards.implementationBoundary: IEEE SCC21 list. Physical equipment implements functions; no software library establishes conformance.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.reference: IEEE 1547.1-2020; P1547.1a in ballot in owner list
standards.applicability: Core tests
standards.operationalRole: Interconnection equipment test procedures; laboratory reports and commissioning evidence
standards.implementationBoundary: IEEE SCC21. Simulation/replay are preparation, not accredited equipment certification.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.reference: IEEE 2030.7-2017 active; revision project P2030.7 listed
standards.applicability: Core controller
standards.operationalRole: Microgrid controller functions above component control: autonomous/grid-connected operation and transition; allocation to deterministic supervisory controller
standards.implementationBoundary: IEEE2030.7. No public implementation has been verified as fully conformant here.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.applicability: Core tests
standards.operationalRole: Controller test procedures and performance comparisons independent of topology; acceptance test plan for site modes
standards.implementationBoundary: IEEE2030.8. HELICS/OpenDSS/GridLAB-D are test infrastructure, not implementations of the standard's certification.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.reference: IEEE1547.2-2023, .3-2023 cybersecurity, .4-2011 island systems in revision, .9-2022 storage
standards.applicability: Application guides
standards.operationalRole: Engineering interpretation; microgrid island/protection design; storage-specific interconnection
standards.implementationBoundary: IEEE SCC21. Guides supplement—not substitute for—utility agreement and engineered protection.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.reference: IEEE2030.5-2023; supersedes2018; Corrigendum1-2024; CSIP edition must be selected for utility
standards.applicability: Preferred US DER application protocol when utility profile supports
standards.operationalRole: Discovery, monitoring, scheduled DER controls, events/status; native REST/XML and utility-specific security/profile conformance
standards.implementationBoundary: IEEE2030.5 official, SCC21 projects. CUPID is an experimental alternative extension (see implementation inventory), not our native wire-conformance proof.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.
standards.sourceNote: IEEE owner project list; native utility profile and catalog edition must be pinned at acquisition.

standards.reference: IEEE1815 DNP3 plus IEEE1815.2-2025 DER profile, published/announced Feb2026
standards.applicability: Alternative utility SCADA/DER interface
standards.operationalRole: Utility-scale solar/storage/load controls and status. Pin base1815 edition and exact1815.2 point profile at design freeze
standards.implementationBoundary: IEEE1815.2, DNP/MESA announcement. No unrestricted maintained DNP stack is selected in this study.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.reference: SunSpec Modbus information models, especially7xx for modern DER
standards.applicability: Device-cohort alternative
standards.operationalRole: Asset nameplate, measurements, enter-service, P/Q curves and storage capability; map firmware-specific implemented models, scale factors, unavailable values and write permissions
standards.implementationBoundary: SunSpec Modbus, pySunSpec2. Library can read/write RTU/TCP, not prove inverter compliance or secure-channel coverage.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.applicability: IEC semantic core
standards.operationalRole: DER and distribution automation logical nodes, storage/load/generation aggregation, microgrid EMS
standards.implementationBoundary: IEC catalog. Choose explicit logical-node/data-object subset; libIEC61850 transport/model tooling still needs correct7-420 instance model.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.reference: IEC61850-8-1:2011+AMD1:2020 Ed2.1; companion -6 SCL, -7-2/-7-3/-7-4 as pinned per IED
standards.applicability: Conditional station/IED integration
standards.operationalRole: MMS and Ethernet mapping, SCL engineering, control/report semantics; GOOSE/SV only in engineered protection paths
standards.implementationBoundary: IEC8-1, libIEC61850. Raw GOOSE/SV are not TLS sockets; select IEC62351 mechanism and isolated deterministic station design rather than claiming mTLS on every frame.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.reference: IEC TR61850-90-7:2023 Ed2; technical report, not normative certification standard
standards.applicability: Function guidance
standards.operationalRole: Power-converter operating functions informing P/Q/voltage/frequency control models
standards.implementationBoundary: IEC authorized preview. No public code is independently certified to the whole report.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.reference: IEC61970-301:2020+AMD1:2022 Ed7.1; relevant61968 extensions and61970-552 serialization/profile subset
standards.applicability: Distribution/EMS model
standards.operationalRole: Asset identity/mRID, topology, connectivity/phases, measurements and network model exchange. Select exact61968 parts/editions with utility; avoid guessing all-part latest edition
standards.implementationBoundary: IEC61970 current series2026, CIMHub, CIM-Lab. Profile/extension round-trip tests required; no blanket CIM conformance.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.reference: IEC62325-301:2018 Ed2 plus applicable market-specific profile
standards.applicability: Conditional market exchange
standards.operationalRole: Market participation, registration, weather context and settlement artifacts, only where utility/ISO/RTO requires
standards.implementationBoundary: IEC62325. No market adapter selected; wholesale authority, tariffs and jurisdiction determine implementation.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.reference: OCPP2.0.1 or2.1 selected by charger cohort;2.1 introduced2025 and accepted as IEC63584-210:2025; freeze latest exact OCA edition/errata
standards.applicability: Conditional EVSE backend
standards.operationalRole: Charging-station management, smart charging, status, firmware and certificates;2.1 adds bidirectional/DER functions
standards.implementationBoundary: OCA2025 report, OCA FAQ, EVerest libocpp. Existing OCA certification claims apply to identified product/hardware/profile, not every downstream build.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.applicability: Conditional EV-to-EVSE
standards.operationalRole: Vehicle negotiation, power transfer/bidirectional sequence and Plug&Charge; certificate lifecycle and supported feature negotiation

standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.reference: MQTT5.0 and OPC UA / IEC62541, selected per adapter
standards.applicability: Internal integration option
standards.operationalRole: Telemetry/event distribution and equipment integration; timestamps, quality, retained/expired messages, namespaces and control permissions
standards.implementationBoundary: Mosquitto, open62541. MQTT is a messaging protocol, not a DER semantic model. OPC UA native secure channels differ from TLS; profile must resolve project transport contract before admission.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.reference: IEEE1588-2019; power profile IEEE C37.238-2017 or utility-selected IEC/IEEE61850-9-3 profile

standards.operationalRole: Clock identity, uncertainty, drift, holdover and time quality; precise synchronization for protection/phasors only when required
standards.implementationBoundary: IEEE profiles owner list, LinuxPTP. PTP support does not establish desired accuracy under GNSS spoofing or bad grandmaster.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.reference: IEEE C37.118 communications family plus applicable current measurement standard, exact editions to be frozen
standards.applicability: Conditional PMU
standards.operationalRole: Synchrophasor streams/time quality for dynamic monitoring; not required for every small microgrid
standards.implementationBoundary: IEEE1588 explanation. No PMU implementation selected; verify C37.118.2 and IEC/IEEE60255-118-1 editions before procurement.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.applicability: Power-quality methods
standards.operationalRole: Repeatable measurement, class, voltage/frequency/unbalance/harmonics/dips/swells; measurement method is distinct from allowed operating limit
standards.implementationBoundary: IEC4-30. Use calibrated instruments and accredited reports; no OSS certification claim.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.applicability: Storage electrical safety

standards.implementationBoundary: IEC62933. Physical BMS, OEM evidence and independent assessment; no software substitute.
standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.

standards.editionStatus: Owner catalog checked; exact amendments and adopted utility/AHJ profile must be frozen before use.
